skills.name: Black Kite's Enigma
skills.descriptionraw: Character's own Normal Attacks will not generate $[K310].\nAfter performing a Normal Attack: If possible, consume all $[K310] and deal $[K5] equal to the amount consumed +1 to the enemy with the lowest HP.
skills.descriptionreplaced: Character's own Normal Attacks will not generate <color=#FFFFFFFF>{SPRITE_PRESET#1110}Energy</color>.\nAfter performing a Normal Attack: If possible, consume all <color=#FFFFFFFF>{SPRITE_PRESET#1110}Energy</color> and deal <color=#FFFFFFFF>Piercing DMG</color> equal to the amount consumed +1 to the enemy with the lowest HP.
skills.description:
Character's own Normal Attacks will not generate Energy.
After performing a Normal Attack: If possible, consume all Energy and deal Piercing DMG equal to the amount consumed +1 to the enemy with the lowest HP.
